data.name: Mu'Adhah
data.gender_notes: Mu'Adhah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that signifies assistance or support, reminding us of the importance of helping others. The name Mu'Adhah carries the meaning “One who assists or supports” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mu'Adhah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who assists or supports and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Quranic verse 9:72, 'And indeed, Allah supports His Messenger, the believers, and the truthful.'
data.etymology: Mu'Adhah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who assists or supports.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mu'Adhah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: معاذة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم معاذة هو اسم مؤنث يعود إلى الجذر العربي 'ع و ذ' والذي يعني الحماية أو العون. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَعَهِدۡتُكُمۡ أَلَّا تَعۡثُواْ فِی ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا تُعۡثِيَ فۡیہَا فَسَادٗا' (الإسراء: ٢٦)، حيث يشير إلى العهد والحماية. يعتبر اسم معاذة من الأسماء الجميلة والرقيقة التي تحمل معاني عميقة وروحانية، ويتميز بالبساطة والجمال في نفس الوقت.

in_urdu.name: معاذہ
in_urdu.meaning: معاذہ کا مطلب ہے حفاظت یا مدد
in_urdu.long_meaning: معاذہ ایک خوبصورت اور دلکش نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے جڑ 'ع و ذ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت یا مدد کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے اور اس کا استعمال اکثر ایک خوبصورت اور روحانی معنی کے ساتھ کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس نام کی تعبیر اس سے ملتی ہے کہ یہ فرد کو محفوظ اور محترم سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुआदाह
in_hindi.meaning: मुआदाह का अर्थ है सुरक्षा या सहायता
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुआदाह एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी मूल के शब्द 'ع و ذ' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा या सहायता। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है और अक्सर इसे एक पवित्र और आध्यात्मिक अर्थ के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस नाम का महत्व इस बात में निहित है कि यह व्यक्ति को सुरक्षित और सम्मानित मानता है।

in_pashto.name: معاذه
in_pashto.meaning: معاذه د حفاظت یا د مرست معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: معاذه يو ښکلی او معنوي نوم دی چی د عربي کلمو 'ع و ذ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، هغه د حفاظت یا د مرست معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې مشهور دی او ډیری وختونه د دې لپاره کارول کیږي چې یو څوک خوندي او درناوی وکړي.

in_english.name: Mu'Adhah
in_english.long_meaning: Mu'Adhah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'ع و ذ' (ʿ-w-ḏ), which conveys the meanings of protection, assistance, or refuge. This root appears in several Quranic verses, emphasizing the concepts of safeguarding and covenant. The name Mu'Adhah symbolizes a person who is protected, respected, and valued. It is cherished in Islamic tradition for its beautiful and profound significance, reflecting virtues of care and support.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mu'Adhah carries a strong cultural impact as it embodies the essential Islamic virtue of helping others and providing support. In Islamic societies, family, community, and neighbors are highly valued, and the act of supporting one another is a fundamental aspect of daily life. The name Mu'Adhah can serve as a gentle reminder for parents to instill this important value in their children. Furthermore, it can also inspire individuals to contribute positively to their communities and make a difference in the lives of those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mu'Adhah draws from the social justice teachings in Islam, which emphasizes the importance of providing assistance to those in need. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) stated, "The strong is not the one who overpowers the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger" (Al-Bukhari). This hadith teaches us the importance of self-control and demonstrating patience and compassion when helping others. By bearing the name Mu'Adhah, an individual can strive to embody these essential qualities, reflecting the true essence of the Islamic principles of kindness and compassion towards all beings. The name calls upon us to offer support and assistance, not only as a social responsibility, but also as an opportunity to join in God's work, amidst the inherent struggle between good and evil in this world. Through this act of giving, we not only improve the lives of those we help, but we also enhance our own spiritual growth, drawing closer to God and fulfilling His command to be of benefit to others.
